subject: Goodwill proposal for Finova latency incident — exec sign-off needed
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@finova.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: Finova SRE Team <sre@finova.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Increased latency and missed SLOs 2027-07-10 — impact summary

Olga,

Thanks for taking this. On Saturday (2027-07-10) we observed sustained tail latency spikes on the /v1/generate route between 03:15–04:05 PDT. Our monitoring shows p95 went from ~260ms to 1.8s and p99 to 2.9s for that window. We had 9 production customers impacted (two churned their trial pipelines), and our CSAT for that day dropped significantly.

We're requesting a formal SLO remediation and a goodwill concession for the customer impact: Finova is asking for a billing credit equivalent to 2 months of average spend or an alternative of a $40k usage credit, plus a written remediation plan and SLA adjustments for high-volume backfills.

I've attached our incident summary and logs. Please let me know next steps and an expected timeline for a response.

Sara Patel
Head of Platform
Finova

Attachments: Finova_incident_export.zip (log stubs)

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Sara Patel <sara@finova.com>
Date: 2027-07-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Increased latency and missed SLOs 2027-07-10 — impact summary

Sara —

Really sorry about the disruption and thank you for the clear impact summary. I've looped our SRE and account teams and attached our preliminary remediation plan. We are committed to a formal root cause postmortem and a concrete set of mitigations (KV cache tuning + regional routing adjustments) by Friday.

On standard terms, our published SLO credit policy would yield ~1 month of usage credit for this outage window. I understand that's likely below what you're asking. I will escalate an ask to leadership for a discretionary goodwill package and get back with an approved offer by Thu COB.

Could you confirm whether Finova prefers a time-based billing offset (months free) or a dollar usage credit? That will help me prepare the term sheet.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SLA_remediation_plan.docx

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-13T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Request: executive approval for Finova goodwill beyond standard SLO credit

Team —

Summary: Finova (enterprise account, ~$120k/month ARR, high-touch onboarding) experienced a latency incident on 2027-07-10 that produced missed SLOs and customer impact across several downstream clients. Per policy, credit = ~1 month of usage (~$120k). Customer is asking for an alternative of 2 months or $40k usage credit (they proposed).

Ask: Approve a discretionary concession beyond policy: proposed offer is either (A) two months credit (approx $240k) OR (B) $40k usage credit + one month free (hybrid). We are requesting leadership sign-off because the two-month option exceeds the delegated approval threshold for sales.

Considerations:
- Retention risk: Finova has already lost trial customers; this is a visible enterprise account.
- Precedent: We should avoid a blanket 2-month concession for small incidents — recommending we tie any concession to acceptance of the remediation timeline and a 12-month renewal term.
- Accounting/recognition: Need finance input on revenue impact and how to book the credit.

Attachments: Finova_impact_summary.pdf, proposed-goodwill-term-sheet.pdf

Please respond with approval, any caps, or alternative language by EOD today.

Olga

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-13T10:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: executive approval for Finova goodwill beyond standard SLO credit

Thanks for the packet, Olga. Quick thoughts:
- I can authorize up to $75k in usage credit or one month free without further escalation. Anything above that requires CFO/Head of Revenue concurrence.
- I like the hybrid approach (one month + $40k) if Finance signs off on the revenue treatment.
- Condition the concession on a 12-month committed renewal or a written acceptance of the remediation plan and a joint postmortem. We should also require acknowledgement that this is an exception not a precedent.

Action items for Olga: include acceptance language in the term sheet and route to Legal for a short amendment. If Finance OKs, I'll sign.

Vivek
VP, Revenue Operations

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-13T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: executive approval for Finova goodwill beyond standard SLO credit

Accounting note:
- $240k two-month credit is material relative to the account; we'd need CFO approval for write-off and it will impact recognized ARR for the quarter.
- $40k usage credit + one month free can be treated as deferred revenue adjustment under promotional credit and spread over the next billing cycle; smaller immediate P&L impact.
- Recommend approving the hybrid (one month + $40k) with an explicit renewal commitment (12 months) and the customer signing the amendment. Code GL: PROMO-CRED-07.

I'll flag this with Finance leadership; if they don't push back by EOD, consider it OK to proceed with Legal.

Rishi
Director, Finance

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Sara Patel <sara@finova.com>
Cc: Finova SRE Team <sre@finova.com>, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-15T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Final: proposed goodwill arrangement and next steps

Sara —

Thanks again for your patience. Leadership and Finance have approved a discretionary, one-time goodwill package contingent on a signed amendment:

Offer (final):
- One month billing credit (equivalent to Finova's current monthly subscription) PLUS a $40,000 usage credit applied over the next two billing cycles.
- Condition: Finova signs the attached amendment agreeing to the remediation plan, a joint postmortem within 10 business days, and a 12-month renewal commitment at current tier pricing.
- We will expedite the remediation tasks (KV cache tuning + routing adjustments) and share the RCA within 5 business days.

Next steps:
1) I'll route the short amendment to your legal team via DocuSign (link included).
2) We will schedule the joint postmortem for next week.
3) Upon signed amendment, we'll apply the credits to the next invoice.

If this aligns, I'll send the DocuSign and the term sheet for signature. Appreciate working through this with you — we want to make this right and keep Finova as a strategic partner.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Sales Manager, Enterprise
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed-goodwill-term-sheet.pdf, Finova_impact_summary.pdf
